title: Can I MASTER Atomic Chess?
summary: Five online Atomic games vs ~1500-1600 humans at 3-minute; thumbnail radiation symbol.
rules: Every capture causes an explosion: the capturing piece, the captured piece, and all non-pawn pieces on the 8 surrounding squares are removed.
Pawns are only destroyed if directly captured or capturing.
Exploding the enemy king wins immediately; you cannot make a capture that explodes your own king.
Kings cannot capture. Adjacent kings: check does not apply while kings touch.
win_condition: Explode the enemy king or checkmate.

opponent.name: online human opponents (chess.com Variants)
